Take the table to be \(8\) units wide and \(6\) units high, with coordinates
\[
D=(0,0),\quad A=(8,0),\quad B=(8,6),\quad C=(0,6),
\]
so the bounce point is \(P=(4,0)\).

After the bounce at \(P\), the ball moves up-right with slope
\[
\tan\theta=\frac12.
\]
Its path is
\[
y=\frac{x-4}{2}.
\]
It first hits the right side \(x=8\) at
\[
y=\frac{8-4}{2}=2,
\]
so the collision point is \((8,2)\).

Reflecting off the right wall reverses the horizontal component, making the new slope \(-\tfrac12\). Thus the next segment is
\[
y-2=-\frac12(x-8)
\quad\Rightarrow\quad
y=6-\frac{x}{2}.
\]
This meets the left side \(x=0\) at
\[
y=6.
\]
Hence the ball reaches the top-left corner simultaneously, which is pocket \(C\).

\[
\boxed{\text{C: Pocket C (top-left)}}
\]
